scope: Owner-directed intended-client live-test repairs, with Current preserved and a persistent top-centered Talk control, no acoustic interruption, retained sign-in, repository meal context and bounded Outlook recovery/preparation. No full-slice acceptance.

baseline.scope: Mixed recent diagnostic observations; not a controlled benchmark or proof of actual audibility.

findings.connector: At inspection the existing live connection was reconnect_required with deleted token and resource selections. Ordinary local authorization failure could erase otherwise durable consent. Existing Microsoft administrator consent/sole-user assignment/scopes are not repeated.
findings.personalization: The saved authorized profile lacked the reported ongoing dietary context. This repair does not invent a diagnosis, prescribed diet or permanent real-person note.

preparation.explicit_private_permission: preparationApproved, default false; enabled for the existing exact approved live account by the October 21 direction.
preparation.scheduler: Existing durable scheduler; 06:00–11:00 participant-local, no more than one attempt per five minutes; startup catch-up within the window.
preparation.scope: Coming seven local days of selected calendars, independent past-seven-day selected Inbox; encrypted bounded snapshot, five-minute freshness maximum and fresh authority checks.

full_regression.scope: Complete suite before the final meal-choice context presentation reduction.

final_prompt_regression.scope: Final choice-summary projection, source integrity, nutrition, conversation/governance and Outlook context regression.

actual_postgresql.scope: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL; actual row-lock budget, schema 017–020 upgrades, rollback and prior 018/019 encrypted restoration, authentication expiry/rotation, scoped preparation and reviewed-action safety.

actual_owner_practice.scope: Synthetic owner-practice account only. No real-person microphone, audible timing, actual Outlook content or care writes.

prompt_size.limitations: One sample per meal presentation. Cache observations differ (4224 cached input tokens before, 0 afterward); model time still dominates. First audio available is not first useful audible response.

public_scan.scope: Final publication scan including this sanitized evidence file.

remaining.latency: Open: the final synthetic three-meal test took 7872 ms for its typed reply and 990 ms to fetch the first audio part. This is not a conversational-speed pass or a person/device acceptance result.
remaining.outlook: Interactive approved-client reconnect and selected resources are required; the live connection remains reconnect_required. No deleted token is resurrected and earlier email/invitation tests are not repeated.
remaining.phone: Retest intended iPhone/Safari sticky placement, permission persistence, pause/Stop, wake-lock, pronunciation and useful response timing.
remaining.clinical: No prescribed targets or clinical protocol supplied; generic references and reviewed self-reported context do not replace approved instructions.
remaining.scheduled_preparation: An actual morning/provider read after reconnect is awaiting_live_test.
